Wiring Swagger UI and XML Comments

Swashbuckle generates an OpenAPI document from the controllers and serves Swagger UI to explore it. Enabling the XML documentation file surfaces the doc comments as endpoint descriptions, and a security definition adds the Authorize button so a token can be entered and sent with every try-it-out request.

data.title: A complete Swashbuckle setup
Keep the document out of production, or protect it
data.text: The OpenAPI document is a map of your API for an attacker: every route, every parameter, every error shape. Serving Swagger UI in production is a choice, not a default — either gate it behind an environment check as above or put it behind authentication and a non-guessable path. Documenting the API for developers is not the same as publishing it to the world.
